about: Khanty-Mansiysk International Airport, managed by JSC Yugraavia. Open round the clock. The terminal complex with an international sector opened in 2001; a state border crossing point has operated since 2004.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Bus No. 3 Vostochny microdistrict – Poliklinika – Vostochny microdistrict runs from 6:00 to 0:00. Bus No. 5 Vostochny microdistrict – Ledovy Dvorets runs from 5:00 to 1:00. By car via Obyezdnaya St, Vostochnaya Obyezdnaya, Mira St or Tobolsky Trakt.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Business lounge for business class passengers and GOLD and PLATINUM members of airline programmes. Others pay 3,500 ₽ for 3 hours, then 700 ₽ per hour. Bank loyalty cards do not give free entry. VIP lounge for departure 10,000 ₽.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: Sokol hotel within walking distance of the airport and the bus stop, 43 rooms. Economy single from 2,500 ₽ per day, standard from 3,150 ₽. There is an evening rate from 20:00 to 6:00.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room for passengers with children under 7, children with disabilities under 14 and women from the second half of pregnancy. Admission 6 hours before departure and up to 3 hours after arrival, free of charge. First a medical check at the health post; passport, birth certificate and ticket required.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Station forecourt: up to 20 minutes free, from minute 21 to 4 hours 300 ₽ per hour, a part hour counts as a full hour. From the 5th hour 1,200 ₽ per day, following days 1,200 ₽. A repeat entry within 20 minutes is paid, 300 ₽ per hour.
